answer.explanation: Every CompressionFunction invocation in the window fails at handler.py line 37 with NoSuchBucket on PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET, while other functions run normally. NoSuchBucket means the bucket name resolved at runtime does not exist. It is not AccessDenied, so the execution role is not the cause. The most likely cause is that the OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable points to a missing or misnamed bucket. The IaC template is the second candidate, since it may define the wrong bucket name or omit the bucket resource. The code is the third candidate because it passes that name through unchanged. The logs alone cannot distinguish these, but the configuration layer is the most direct explanation.
